Definition: properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)
BiblicalUsage: 1) sacrifice; 1a) sacrifices of righteousness; 1b) sacrifices of strife; 1c) sacrifices to dead things; 1d) the covenant sacrifice; 1e) the passover; 1f) annual sacrifice; 1g) thank offering
